title: Fix IsWeeklyWindow scheduling gap (no catch-up, no TSK ticket despite 2-month-old documentation)
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG1-12 (memorysmith-auditcorpus-discovery-26-07-19-22-54-17, originally documented in hyperagent-audit-3-sqlite-background-tokenizer-20260528.md §2.2)

## Problem
`IsWeeklyWindow` is a single-hour equality check (`localNow.Hour == WeeklyHourLocal`), polled every 5 minutes, with no catch-up/grace-window mechanism. If the host is down during the scheduled slot, the entire week's run is silently skipped. Documented as HIGH/0.90 over 2 months ago but never converted to a TSK ticket.

## Severity
High

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/MaintenanceAgentServices.cs` (IsWeeklyWindow logic)

## Recommendation
Add grace window (e.g., run within 1 hour of scheduled time if missed) or catch-up mechanism. Create TSK ticket using the existing detailed writeup directly.

## Existing Coverage
No existing task. Was documented in hyperagent audit corpus but never tasked.
